name: tinyorbit
description: Matt's Claude Code mods: plugins of function hooks that draw live panes and steer the agent loop. Skills ship separately through npx skills.

plugins.name: agent-atc
plugins.description: Air-traffic control for subagents: a live pane listing every agent, what each one is doing now, and controls to message or stop one. Open it with /atc.

plugins.name: forge-gate
plugins.description: Enforces the forge phase gate: shows whether the current phase's Verifiable gate is green on this exact working tree, and blocks a 'phase done' claim until it is. /gate runs it.
